description: Canonical JSON (RFC 8785) vectors of SPEC-0003 AC49. Each input is a JSON text; canonical is its canonical form and sha256 the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Numbers are read by value (plan of SPEC-0001, Numbers): an integer written with a fraction or an exponent is accepted as an input and written in its canonical form, while a stored ledger line that holds it is not canonical (SPEC-0003 R59). Refused inputs carry the reason of the error; input_base16 gives bytes that are not UTF-8.
